lintedByDefault.source: measured, oxlint 1.87 CLI on one file of each type: it lints these, declaration files among them, and no .json, .md, .html or .css file

declarationFiles.source: read from oxc tag oxlint_v1.87.0, crates/oxc_span/src/source_type.rs, is_ts_declaration: a .ts file with .d. in its name after its first character, and a .d.mts or .d.cts file; measured with no-unused-vars, silent in a.d.ts, b.d.mts and x.d.css.ts

guards.source: read from each rule's should_run, oxc tag oxlint_v1.87.0 (crates/oxc_linter/src/rules): TypeScript only (source_type is_typescript). The script of a .vue, .svelte or .astro file is TypeScript where lang="ts" says so, which no glob tells, so those files count as TypeScript. Measured, oxlint 1.87 CLI: typescript/no-this-alias reports in a.ts and in .vue, .svelte and .astro files with lang="ts", not in a.js or c.cjs; typescript/ban-ts-comment in a.ts and a .vue with lang="ts", not in a.js, a.mjs or a .vue with a plain script
